description: Comment “HeyGen” and I’ll send you the full setup guide 👇 Claude plus HeyGen may have just changed the way you edit videos forever. You can now edit any video using plain text directly inside Claude. Here’s how to set it up in 60 seconds: 1. Google “Hyperframes quick start” and click the first link 2. Scroll down and copy the command 3. Go to Claude → Code → paste it in → hit Enter Hyperframes is now officially connected inside Claude. I uploaded a video of my HeyGen avatar talking about AI agents and said: “/hyperframes. Edit this video for me with split screens, animations, and captions in 9x16.” Claude opened its own video editor and built the entire thing. It codes everything using HTML, actually writing real code to create every frame, transition, and animation. Want to change something? Just ask Claude and it updates it directly in the editor. You can create animated slides, explainer videos, and full motion graphics just by talking to it in plain English. Video editing has never been this accessible. #HeyGenPartner
